description: Unrelenting Force as the action skill, one row per word. Word names and cooldowns come from the player's Skyrim.esm (SHOU/WOOP); force and reach are this mashup's.

columns.woop_edid: Skyrim WOOP editor id of the word this row adds
columns.unlock_level: Dragonborn (Skyrim character) level that teaches the word
columns.range_uu: reach in Unreal units (about 50 per metre)
columns.cone_deg: half-angle of the cone in front of the player
columns.push_speed: knockback speed given to each enemy (uu/s)
columns.lift_speed: upward speed given to each enemy (uu/s)
columns.damage_frac: damage as a fraction of each enemy's max health
columns.camera_anim: BL2 CameraAnim played on the player
columns.in_game: yes once seen working in the running game
